title: Night Cream for Oily, Acne-Prone Skin: How to Choose One That Will Not Feel Heavy

quick: Oily, acne-prone skin still needs moisture. Choose a light, non-greasy gel-cream with a readable ingredient list, use a pea-sized amount, patch test first, keep the routine short and do not pick at pimples. For painful or persistent acne, see a dermatologist.
